items.stem: "Reserved constituencies were created for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes." Examine this statement with reference to why India adopted first past the post and reserved constituencies.
items.answer: The statement is valid. These groups would otherwise have found it difficult to get elected in a fair proportion.
items.markingKey: 3 marks: 1 for accepting or qualifying the statement, 1 for the reason (these groups would otherwise have found it difficult to get elected in a fair proportion.), 1 for supporting evidence from the chapter.

items.stem: Distinguish between 'universal adult franchise' and 'Election Commission'.
items.answer: Universal adult franchise: the right of all adult citizens to vote, without discrimination of caste, religion, sex, education or wealth. Election Commission: the independent constitutional body under Article 324 that supervises elections to Parliament, state legislatures, President and Vice-President.
items.markingKey: 2 marks: 1 for explaining 'universal adult franchise' (the right of all adult citizens to vote, without discrimination of caste, religion, sex, education or wealth.) and 1 for 'Election Commission' (the independent constitutional body under Article 324 that supervises elections to Parliament, state legislatures, President and Vice-President.), with the contrast made clear.

items.stem: What is meant by 'direct democracy' in the context of elections and systems of election?
items.answer: A system in which citizens directly take part in day-to-day decision-making and in running the government.
items.markingKey: 1 mark: direct democracy correctly explained as a system in which citizens directly take part in day-to-day decision-making and in running the government.

items.answer: I and II only

items.stem:

(a) Give a reason for the following: Representative democracy is practised in modern states. (2)
(b) The following statement is incorrect. Rewrite it correctly and give one supporting fact: "Under proportional representation each constituency elects only one member." (2)
items.answer: (a) It is not possible for millions of citizens to take every decision directly. (b) Under PR a constituency may elect several representatives.
items.markingKey: 4 marks: (a) 2 for the reason – it is not possible for millions of citizens to take every decision directly. (b) 2 for the corrected statement – Under PR a constituency may elect several representatives. Credit a relevant supporting fact from the NCERT chapter.

items.stem:
Read the following extract on elections and systems of election and answer the questions that follow.
"In India, proportional representation is used for the elections of the President, the Vice-President, the Rajya Sabha and the Legislative Councils. Under the first past the post system, a party may win many more seats than its share of votes. In the first past the post system, the winning candidate need not get a majority of the votes."
(i) In the first past the post system, the winning candidate needs: (1)
(ii) Explain the term 'constituency' as it relates to this theme. (1)
(iii) Explain the reason behind the following: A party may win a large majority of seats with a minority of votes under first past the post. (2)
items.answer: (i) more votes than any other candidate (ii) A geographical area whose voters elect one or more representatives. (iii) The candidate with the most votes in each constituency wins even without a majority.
items.markingKey: 1+1+2 marks: (i) more votes than any other candidate (ii) A geographical area whose voters elect one or more representatives. (iii) The candidate with the most votes in each constituency wins even without a majority.
